title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #12

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In which surah does Allah praise the Prophet's great character? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Masad
   B. An-Nasr
   C. Al-Ikhlas
   D. Al-Qalam (68:4)

2. Why should Muslims not overeat? (1 mark)
   A. It saves money
   B. It is a sport
   C. It can make us sick and lazy
   D. It makes us fast

3. What should we say after finishing a meal? (1 mark)
   A. Inna lillahi
   B. Amin
   C. Alhamdulillah
   D. Bismillah

4. Which food is worst for teeth if we do not brush after? (1 mark)
   A. Cabbage
   B. Sweets and sugary drinks
   C. Plain rice
   D. Water

5. Which hand do we use to hold the siwak? (1 mark)
   A. Both feet
   B. Left hand only
   C. Neither
   D. Right hand

6. Which habit protects teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Never rinsing
   B. Eating sweets all day
   C. Brushing twice a day
   D. Sharing toothbrushes

7. Which angel brings revelation to the prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Mikail
   B. Jibril
   C. Israfil
   D. Malakul Maut

8. Another name for the Angel of Death is (1 mark)
   A. Israfil
   B. Jibril
   C. Izrail
   D. Mikail

9. What is the difference between a nabi and a rasul? (1 mark)
   A. A rasul is a jinn
   B. A rasul is a prophet given a message or book to deliver
   C. They are the same in every way
   D. A nabi is an angel

10. Which of these is NOT a najasa? (1 mark)
   A. Stool
   B. Blood that flows
   C. Human sweat
   D. Vomit

11. Which of these is a najasa? (1 mark)
   A. Urine
   B. Milk
   C. Sweat
   D. Clean water

12. What is a good habit for cleaning after using the toilet? (1 mark)
   A. Use water and wash hands with soap
   B. Use nothing
   C. Leave it
   D. Skip washing

13. Which is a condition of swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Taslim
   B. Facing the Qibla
   C. Bowing
   D. Prostrating

14. What should a person do if unable to stand for obligatory prayer because of illness? (1 mark)
   A. Pray sitting
   B. Skip the prayer
   C. Wait until well
   D. Pray later in the year

15. What does the Qur'an say about everything in the heavens and earth? (1 mark)
   A. They are useless
   B. They glorify Allah
   C. They ignore Him
   D. They are silent

16. Which of these fits the Islamic code of dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Torn on purpose
   B. See-through
   C. Very tight
   D. Loose, clean and modest

17. What is the awrah? (1 mark)
   A. A fast
   B. The parts of the body that must be covered
   C. A prayer
   D. A cap

18. With which side should we start when putting on shoes? (1 mark)
   A. Left
   B. Neither
   C. Right
   D. Either

19. Which of these is internet media? (1 mark)
   A. A video website
   B. A newspaper
   C. A book
   D. A poster

20. How can too much screen time affect a child? (1 mark)
   A. Improves health
   B. Makes them taller
   C. Wastes time and harms eyes and sleep
   D. Helps prayer

21. How can children show thanks to parents? (1 mark)
   A. Compare them with others
   B. Say thank you and make dua for them
   C. Complain
   D. Ignore them

22. What does "Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira" mean? (1 mark)
   A. My Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small
   B. Guide us to the straight path
   C. Praise Allah
   D. Say He is Allah

23. What can a child do when a parent is sick? (1 mark)
   A. Bring water, help and make dua
   B. Play loudly
   C. Ignore
   D. Leave

24. Which action helps keep family ties? (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding
   B. Visiting relatives
   C. Envy
   D. Gossiping

25. What should you do when relatives have a quarrel? (1 mark)
   A. Forgive and make peace
   B. Gossip
   C. Spread stories
   D. Take sides in anger

26. Which of these was freed by Abu Bakr? (1 mark)
   A. Waraqa
   B. Abu Talib
   C. Abu Lahab
   D. Bilal

27. What does "convert" mean? (1 mark)
   A. A traveller
   B. A teacher
   C. A trader
   D. A person who accepts a new faith

28. What can we learn from Ali about young people? (1 mark)
   A. Even young people can accept truth and be brave
   B. Children cannot help
   C. Only adults matter
   D. Children are weak

29. Who travelled with the Prophet to Taif? (1 mark)
   A. Bilal
   B. Zayd ibn Haritha
   C. Abu Bakr
   D. Ali

30. Which virtue is needed if a classmate teases you? (1 mark)
   A. Revenge
   B. Shouting
   C. Fighting
   D. Patience and tolerance

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Describe how Ali (R.A.) accepted Islam and what he did as a young man. (3 marks)

32. Why is Laylat al-Qadr connected to the first revelation? (3 marks)

33. Explain how Prophet Ayyub (A.S.) showed patience. (3 marks)

34. Explain the rule when you are unsure whether wudhu broke. (3 marks)

35. Give three manners of making dua. (3 marks)

36. Explain how not brushing teeth can harm them. (4 marks)

37. Explain the difference between patience and revenge with a school example. (3 marks)

38. Why is betting in a game not allowed? (3 marks)

39. List three rules for staying safe online. (3 marks)

40. How did Prophet Ibrahim (A.S.) show generosity? (3 marks)

41. State four conditions of swalah. (4 marks)

42. State the dua for parents and its meaning. (2 marks)

43. In a group role-play, a child finds Ksh 50 in the school field. Explain what a person of the Prophet's character would do and why. (5 marks)

44. Describe the manners a Muslim should follow when reading the Qur'an. (3 marks)

45. In which cave, and near which city, did the first revelation come? (2 marks)

46. Give three character traits of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and one way to practise each. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #12 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Al-Qalam (68:4)
   Surah Al-Qalam 68:4 speaks about his great standard of character.

2. C — It can make us sick and lazy
   Moderation keeps us healthy.

3. C — Alhamdulillah
   Alhamdulillah thanks Allah for the food.

4. B — Sweets and sugary drinks
   Sugar feeds germs.

5. D — Right hand
   The right hand is used for clean, honourable actions.

6. C — Brushing twice a day
   Regular brushing prevents cavities.

7. B — Jibril
   Jibril brought the Qur'an to the Prophet.

8. C — Izrail
   Izrail is commonly used for Malakul Maut.

9. B — A rasul is a prophet given a message or book to deliver
   A messenger delivers a specific message.

10. C — Human sweat
   Sweat is pure.

11. A — Urine
   Urine must be washed off before prayer.

12. A — Use water and wash hands with soap
   Water is best.

13. B — Facing the Qibla
   Facing Qibla is a condition; bowing is a pillar.

14. A — Pray sitting
   Islam gives ease.

15. B — They glorify Allah
   All creation praises Allah.

16. D — Loose, clean and modest
   Clothes should cover properly.

17. B — The parts of the body that must be covered
   Awrah is what must be covered.

18. C — Right
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

19. A — A video website
   The internet carries websites and videos.

20. C — Wastes time and harms eyes and sleep
   Excess is harmful.

21. B — Say thank you and make dua for them
   Gratitude.

22. A — My Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small
   That is the meaning.

23. A — Bring water, help and make dua
   Care for them.

24. B — Visiting relatives
   Visits strengthen bonds.

25. A — Forgive and make peace
   Islam teaches forgiveness.

26. D — Bilal
   Bilal was freed.

27. D — A person who accepts a new faith
   A convert changes beliefs.

28. A — Even young people can accept truth and be brave
   Ali was a boy.

29. B — Zayd ibn Haritha
   Zayd was his companion.

30. D — Patience and tolerance
   Stay calm.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: He saw the Prophet and Khadija praying, asked, and accepted Islam. He was loyal and brave and slept in the Prophet's bed on the night of the migration.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the points.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: The Qur'an says it was sent down on the Night of Power in Ramadan, which is why Ramadan is special.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the Night of Power, 1 mark for Ramadan, 1 mark for the Qur'an.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: He was tested with illness and loss. He did not complain against Allah, called upon Him, and Allah healed him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the test, 1 mark for not complaining, 1 mark for calling upon Allah.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: If you were sure you made wudhu and only doubt it broke, you remain in wudhu, because certainty is not removed by doubt.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for staying in wudhu, 1 mark for certainty, 1 mark for the example.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: Begin with praise, face the Qibla and raise hands, be humble, be patient, say Amin.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

36. (4 marks)
   Answer: Food and sugar stay on the teeth, germs turn them into acid, and acid makes cavities which cause toothache and bad breath.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the four steps or harms.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: Patience is staying calm and trusting Allah, while revenge is hurting back. If a classmate teases you, you stay calm and tell a teacher instead of fighting.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for patience, 1 mark for revenge, 1 mark for example.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: Gambling is forbidden in Islam because it takes people's wealth unfairly and can cause harm and hatred.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for forbidden, 1 mark for unfairness, 1 mark for harm.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: Never share passwords or address, ask parents' permission, tell an adult about anything uncomfortable.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: When guests came, he quickly brought a fattened calf to serve them and welcomed them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for guests, 1 mark for the food, 1 mark for welcome.

41. (4 marks)
   Answer: Islam and sanity; purity; covering the awrah; facing the Qibla; the time has come.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each condition.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira: My Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for words and 1 mark for meaning.

43. (5 marks)
   Answer: Hand it to the teacher so the owner can be found. Honesty and trustworthiness. It is not ours, and Allah sees everything.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the action, 1 mark for honesty, 1 mark for trust, 1 mark for the reason, 1 mark for a clear explanation.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Be clean and make wudhu if possible, sit calmly, seek Allah's protection from Shaytan and say Bismillah, and read slowly and clearly with tajweed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct manner, up to 3.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: The cave of Hira near Makkah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the cave and 1 mark for the city.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: Trustworthy: return borrowed items. Truthful: tell the truth about mistakes. Kind: share your lunch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each trait with a suitable way.
